title: Possessive pronouns and materials
source: User-provided workbook photo, visible table manually transcribed; illustrated possessive pronoun translations suggested separately

entries.example: In our house, there's lots of furniture.
entries.description: Tables, chairs, beds and cupboards

entries.example: Whose pen is this?
entries.description: ___ jacket is this? Is it Tom's?

entries.example: My mom is American.
entries.description: A person from the USA

entries.example: There's a big cellar underneath our house.
entries.description: A room under a house, below the ground

entries.example: The Mongolian people in Central Asia move their houses a lot.
entries.description: The middle part of the biggest continent, where Mongolia is

entries.example: The trailers can be connected to electricity and water.
entries.description: The power that makes lamps and computers work

entries.example: Fifty islands of reed float on the water.
entries.description: To stay on top of the water and not sink

entries.example: The Mongolian people have moveable houses.
entries.description: Something you can take from one place to another

entries.example: There might be a cellar underneath the house.
entries.description: Under something, below it

entries.example: They can transport their homes.
entries.description: To take things or people from one place to another

entries.example: I have a new hammock. I like sleeping in it.
entries.description: A bed made of cloth or net that hangs between two trees

entries.example: My jacket is made of cotton.
entries.description: A soft material from a plant, used for T-shirts

entries.example: She doesn't wear leather shoes because she wants to protect animals.
entries.description: A material made from animal skin, used for shoes and bags

entries.example: What material did they use to build this house?
entries.description: What something is made of, like wood, glass or cotton

entries.example: It's made of metal.
entries.description: Iron, gold and silver are all this kind of material

entries.example: The shirt has a striped pattern.
entries.description: Lines, spots or shapes that repeat on a shirt

entries.example: It's plain white.
entries.description: All in one colour, with no spots or stripes

entries.example: This bottle is made of plastic.
entries.description: A light material that many bottles and toys are made of

entries.example: She falls in the pond.
entries.description: A small area of water, smaller than a lake

entries.example: Take a seat.
entries.description: A place where you can sit, for example on a bus

entries.example: I can't find my spotted sunglasses.
entries.description: Covered with lots of round dots

entries.example: I've got a watch with a blue strap.
entries.description: A thin piece of leather or cloth, for example on a watch

entries.example: My T-shirt is striped.
entries.description: With lines in different colours, like a zebra

This house belongs to my family and me. It's ___.
